definitions.gloss: partial destruction; being half destroyed (of a building)
definitions.explanation: Damage that wrecks part of a building but leaves it standing. In Japanese disaster reports it is also an official damage grade, between {全壊|ぜんかい} (total destruction) and {一部損壊|いちぶそんかい} (partial damage), which decides the support a household receives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{半壊|はんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧。
examples.english: A building partly destroyed in the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全壊|ぜんかい}→全壊：33190_zenkai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{半壊|はんかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{棟|とう}→〜棟：31576_tou⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon totally or partly destroyed more than a hundred buildings.

notes:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + {壊|かい} (break down). A word of news reports and official damage counts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半壊|はんかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be half destroyed
- {半壊|はんかい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{家屋|かおく}→家屋：00188_kaoku⟧: a partly destroyed house
- ⟦{全壊|ぜんかい}→全壊：33190_zenkai⟧・{半壊|はんかい}: totally and partly destroyed (in damage tallies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全壊|ぜんかい}→全壊：33190_zenkai⟧: total destruction; the grade above {半壊|はんかい}
- ⟦{倒壊|とうかい}→倒壊：25308_toukai⟧: collapse; the building falls down
